facts.note: At nine, when the temple struck, everyone showed watches; hers was exact, Dr Vauthier's two minutes ahead, and Girard would not take his out of his pocket.
Hall clock struck ten while the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten; master said what he always says about that clock. When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
Master sent her downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; the regulator was running and he was well; she went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon she saw the master in the kitchen with Rosa's American alarm clock in his hands, laughing; she did not ask why.
In the kitchen, when the piano began, Rosa's clock showed two minutes to eleven; when the piano stopped it showed eleven minutes past eleven.
She stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
